card.name: Opening parenthesis after a clinical finding
card.fires_on: The opening parenthesis that follows a result, group or drug name in clinical text. The bracket introduces a number, range, percentage or clarifying note.

modes.label: Range or sample size
modes.description: A parenthesis after a measured result that opens a range or N value.
modes.example: Median time to first occurrence of cuSCC/KA was 5.8 months<< (>>range 1 to 9 months)

modes.label: Rate or comparison
modes.description: A parenthesis after a treatment or risk statement that opens a percentage or risk figure.
modes.example: Excessive reduction of blood pressure was rarely seen in patients with uncomplicated hypertension treated with irbesartan alone<< (<>>0.1%) or with irbes

modes.label: Definition or label
modes.description: A parenthesis after a term that opens a gloss or a drug name.

card.writes: It seems to push against symbols and numeric-range tokens, so it has no clear output effect on text.
card.plain: It marks the open bracket where a study result is followed by its numbers, range or explanation.
